test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 12 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A man sold a radio set for Rs. 750 and gained one ninth of its cost price. Find the cost price of the radio and the percentage gain respectively.
solution:
**Given:**

Selling Price (SP) = ₹750

Gain = 1/9 of Cost Price (CP)

**Formula used:**

SP = CP + Gain

Gain = (1/9) × CP

**Calculation:**

750 = CP + (1/9) × CP

⇒ 750 = CP(1 + 1/9)

&rArr
